description: Checks an app (html or zipBase64) against noback's rules, with the limits of an app without an account, without publishing anything or running its code. Use it before create_app or update_app. Returns { ok, errors, warnings }; each item has a code, a message and a fix. Fix every error before publishing; warnings are suggestions and the app works anyway. Without an account, the app can reach the internet only through the services on noback's list. If warnings include NO_APP_DB with certain: true, the app loses what people enter when the page reloads: save it in localStorage (the warning's prompt says what to change) before publishing. If warnings include STATIC_LIST, the content is written by hand in the page: offer to make it editable from the page, with only the owner writing (the warning's prompt says what to ask for). Read-only.

html.description: The complete contents of ONE HTML file, with its CSS and JS inline. Don't add the noback SDK by hand: noback injects window.app. Send html or zipBase64, not both.

zipBase64.description: A complete .zip package encoded in base64, instead of html: index.html at the root, an optional noback.toml, plus scripts, styles and files. Send html or zipBase64, not both.

name: validate_app
